title: CROSS-CULTURAL VALUE ALIGNMENT FRAMEWORKS FOR RESPONSIBLE AI GOVERNANCE: EVIDENCE FROM CHINA-WEST COMPARATIVE ANALYSIS
reasoning: The entire paper is dedicated to evaluating and benchmarking the moral reasoning and ethical value alignment of LLMs. It utilizes an Ethical Dilemma Corpus, Moral Foundations Theory, and Schwartz's Theory of Basic Values to systematically measure how models prioritize conflicting values (e.g., Truth vs. Loyalty) and their adherence to deontological ethical frameworks.
